verdict.rationale: Bento's signals are plain-English failure-mode detectors trained on your traces. They fire in real time on live traffic and also backfill history (bentolabs-docs-4). Releases are scored "offline, in CI, and on live traffic" (bentolabs-docs-14), and shadow-mode changes are scored against production outcomes (bentolabs-docs-12), so continuous evaluation on production traffic is clearly the core design. missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring online evaluators (sampling, custom scorer code, LLM-as-judge setup), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing and FAQ claims.
